items.title: Al Gallodoro Interview, 1966-05-10
items.q: Did you do any with Andre Previn and his score?

ctx.x: Isn't that about a horse? Yes.

What did you read about it? When I was little. Yes, that's right. But it's supposed to be a very good picture and I imagine it's a clean one for a change. Yeah. The scenery is great. The score is very good. It's modern but... Who wrote the score? Oh, born... Not Herman, you didn't know? No, no. I'll have to think of the fellow's name. Young fellow. About 30, 35. But the music is good. I have a few solos here and there. Did you do any with Andre Previn and his score?
Oh, he's got to answer that.
